Bounded downstream three-contrast audit. Preserves individual-contrast protein/GO BH FDR; adds secondary dataset-by-spatial-unit joint control-pair BH families on matched ProteinGroupID/GO-ID universes using raw nominal p-values. SUS-RES remains outside those families. Direct-DAP control-reference geometry is selected only by canonical SUS-RES FDR and is descriptive, not independent validation. Effect/NES trajectories are descriptive; no DA model, GSEA, DAP-set ORA, WGCNA, or behavior model is rerun. The SUS-RES audit workbook is a protected reference artifact, not a Stage-11 input.

Canonical EWCE uses AnimalID x spatial-unit biological replicates: observed left/right hemispheres are aggregated within animal, with biological n=3 animals per condition. Ordinary execution therefore writes EWCE_E9/<dataset>. Sample-level EWCE is retained only as explicit legacy/sensitivity work with PROTEOMICS_EWCE_ANALYSIS_UNIT=sample and a required PROTEOMICS_EWCE_BRANCH, which writes EWCE_E9_comparison/<branch>/<dataset>. Animal cache identity is branch-independent and records cache accounting after completed runs.

Network/module construction from the canonical post-filter quantitative matrix. Supermodules are signed eigengene meta-modules keyed by dataset + SupermoduleID; GO naming uses recurring all-protein module terms at FDR <= 0.05 and hub overlap is audit-only. This is the only stage entry that recomputes core WGCNA state; downstream annotation/reporting should use modules_downstream.
Creates representative all-module GO heatmaps. Module cells are BH-FDR enrichment strengths; supermodule cells are recurrence-weighted member-module summaries, not pooled ORA tests.
Dataset-specific recurrent GO/protein comparison across spatial units; does not alter WGCNA modules.
Curated overlap programs are global biological program sets and are distinct from WGCNA module construction.
Module scoring layer: scores existing module definitions against dataset matrices; does not rebuild WGCNA modules. Dataset fallback is overlap for neuron_neuropil and WGCNA for neuron_soma/microglia.
Bridge layer between WGCNA modules and DE/GSEA manifests; must run after WGCNA and enrichment.

Read-only canonical identity publication. Neuronal authority is the provenance-selected Stage 01 cluster assignment; microglia authority is the current Stage 01 member map. Stage 05-13 inputs are compatibility-audit only and never select membership or labels.

Phase 2B v5 statistical production only. Bilateral values use equal hemisphere weighting after within-hemisphere technical-row means and sha256_utf8_lf_v1 content hashes. Named, full-interaction follow-up, and composite reduced/full omnibus diagnostics have explicit scopes; mixed-model boundaries use the prespecified variance-ratio rule and retain lme4 singularity as a separate diagnostic. The identity contract is the sole membership authority; publication readiness is not assessed. Existing generated Stage 05 migration-status artifacts remain stale until a later authorized refresh; the source migration is complete and claim-facing consumers use only the Stage 07 inferential handoff.

Biological annotation layer. Consumes marker registry, empirical markers, WGCNA outputs, and neuropil annotations when present; microglia labels refer to ROI/local microenvironment unless explicit immune-state evidence is present.
